title: Your signed HPSM-POC feedback has not reached Jira or your email: the review site keeps it in its own list. May a seat read that list?
bluf: Tap a and your feedback gets worked straight away. Your 9:58 note says you had just submitted feedback; none of it is in Jira. The likely reason: the feedback button on the review site saves items in the site's own list and sends nothing on, because that site was set up with delivery off (the sending setting was kept for the demo site only). Your items are safe there, but I cannot read a hosted site without your word. With a, one seat reads that list once, changes nothing, and every item signed - Kam becomes work ahead of everything else. This does not re-ask the route you chose on 29 September; it asks to read what is already saved.

options.label: Read the list once, change nothing
options.detail: One HPSM-POC seat signs in to the review site's admin feedback list and copies your items out, read-only, nothing changed on the site. If the sign-in needs a key we do not hold, the seat stops and I tell you. Each item signed - Kam becomes its own piece of work, ahead of the rest.

options.label: Also switch delivery on for the review site
options.detail: As a, and then the review site is set to send feedback by route A, the route you chose on 29 September (a Jira issue plus an email to you for every new item). That is a settings change and a restart on a hosted site, done by a deploy seat and checked afterwards.

options.label: I will paste them on the board
options.detail: Nothing is read from the site. Paste or forward your items here and each one becomes work as it arrives.

default_action: If you never answer, nothing is read from the site and nothing changes on it. I keep checking Jira every two minutes in case your items arrive there another way.
facts: Jira, read-only search at 10:05: HPSM-POC project, created in the last 2 hours: 0 issues; positive control, last 5 hours: 1 (HPSMPOC-440, ours). Label hp-feedback: 5 issues ever, newest HPSMPOC-230 on 7 October.

HPSM-POC code, main: the shipped default is delivery off, 'items are saved and not sent' (api/src/HpsmPoc.Modules.Feedback/Delivery/IFeedbackSink.cs:110); route A posts to the Jira rule that files the issue and emails kamil.kreiser@datasec.com.au (AutomationWebhookSink.cs:8-9).

Review site settings recorded 24 October (Briefs/2026-10-24_B555_evidence/state/after-uat-state/slotflags-api.txt:17-19): Feedback__Route, the webhook URL and token all absent. B415 kept the feedback route demo-only. The two 1 November review-site deploys (B1031, B1048) do not name the route (0 mentions each; 'uat' 80 and 57).
No issue labelled hp-feedback has appeared since 7 October, so the one marked test item you approved on 21 October (card hpsmpoc-feedback-button-live-proof-1021) has not reached Jira either.
